prompt: The function billing_date(year, month, day, add_months) in solution.py computes a future billing date. Add add_months to the start month and year. The billing day is day, but clamped down to the last valid day of the target month, so a start day of 31 becomes 28 in a non leap February. Return a tuple (year, month, day). It is mostly working but a case in test_visible.py fails. Fix solution.py so all tests pass. Run python -m pytest -q test_visible.py.
diff:
diff --git a/solution.py b/solution.py
index 84df2c2..4dd1e57 100644

+++ b/solution.py
@@ -2,4 +2,16 @@ def billing_date(year, month, day, add_months):
     total = (month - 1) + add_months
     new_year = year + total // 12
     new_month = total % 12 + 1
-    return (new_year, new_month, day)
+
+    # Days in each month (non-leap year)
+    days_in_month = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
+
+    # Adjust February for leap years
+    max_day = days_in_month[new_month - 1]
+    if new_month == 2 and (new_year % 4 == 0 and (new_year % 100 != 0 or new_year % 400 == 0)):
+        max_day = 29
+
+    # Clamp day to the last valid day of the target month
+    new_day = min(day, max_day)
+
+    return (new_year, new_month, new_day)
